The '''Court of Savantae''' was a research organization with various laboratories scattered across Solaris. It was at the cutting edge of research into [[the Lament]] and related phenomena since the original lament 10,000 years ago. While the ruins in [[Whining Aix's Mire]] were used by a group of exiled researchers and do not necessarily represent the whole organisation, the Court appears to have been disbanded by the present day. However, it is known they were active as little as [[Fortress and Gorges War|two hundred years ago]].

It is often abbreviated as CSC (''Court of Savantae Committee''), despite the committee being its leadership group.

==History==
The Court dates back to the time of the first Lament, having built the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative before the [[Etheric Sea]] completely enveloped Solaris and cut off the planet from the rest of the universe. Once the Sea reached the station, it was destroyed and crashed into the [[Roya Frostlands]] near the north pole, where it has remained until today.

The [[Tower of Adversity (Area)|Tower of Adversity]] in [[Jinzhou (Province)|Jinzhou]] is repurposed from an abandoned experiment site once used by the Court.

Researchers from the Court of Savantae often visited [[Mt. Firmament]] to investigate the time fluctuations, despite the cost that it would have on their lifespans. While initially distrusted by the locals, they struck a deal to build Mianloong Chamber's defense mechanisms in return for having their research undisturbed. Changli speculates that their understanding of time manipulation, represented in the Chronosorters, is beyond human comprehension and that they must have received assistance from [[Jué]].<ref>[[To Mt. Firmament]]</ref>

A group of researchers expelled by the Committee for their extreme methods went on to build what is now the [[Court of Savantae Ruins]] with the patronage of an unidentified male Fractsidus Overseer. Seeking to study an ancient civilization they deemed to be "divine beings", their experiments ultimately led to their own deaths by the [[Mech Abomination]] they created.<ref>[[Rewinding Raindrops]]</ref>

Two years prior to the [[Utterance of Marvels: I|arrival of Rover]] at the [[Gorges of Spirits]], while searching for answers regarding his father, [[Xiangli Yao]] once explored the ruins of a Court of Savantae laboratory outside of [[Huanglong]], where he found what seemed to be a portal deep within. Activating the mechanism provided him a glimpse of the mysteries of an ancient civilization, but also cost him his arm and triggered his Awakening after he came in contact with an unknown metal substance. 

The Court collaborated with Sentinel [[Hsin]] to construct [[Xuanfang Hold]] and maintain its mainframe after the destruction of Yuan Fortress.

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
* The Court's name in Chinese means ''court'' or ''government office'' of millet/grain. This provides an interesting link to the {{Lang|Hé civilisation|zh=禾文明}}, whose name is also connected to grain.
* While at first appearing Latin, ''savantae'' is not actually a word in the language. German's use of ''Gelehrten'' (scholars) suggests it may be intended as "Court of Savants," although it may be an intentional corruption of ''sapientae'', which is the actual ancestor of savant.
